content:
Rafael Mendes: weekly check-in for status page transparency upgrades. quick scan of Linear + PRs — want to get us to “ready for limited rollout” by end of next week. 

Rafael Mendes: open items I see:
- ENG-4821 component taxonomy wiring + config validation
- ENG-4822 incident-bot statuspage integration
- ENG-4830 service→component mapping tests
- ENG-4841 component burn alerts
- docs: incident templates + runbook + post-incident summary template final review
- console linking spec signoff (Marissa/Paula tracking but we need copy/constraints review)

Rafael Mendes: pls drop status + any blockers + what you need. also: we need owners for remaining doc reviews + PR approvals.

Talia Benson: :wave: I can run the “who owns what” list. Here’s what I have from last week’s notes, please correct:
- taxonomy + mapping: Christine + Ravi
- observability signals/dashboards: Allison + Aisha
- incident-bot: Devon (Miles advising)
- docs language: Elliot + Wei
- dedicated/private comms constraints: Kira

Talia Benson: I’ll also update PM-620 launch plan with dates once we confirm what’s landing this week.

Christine Wong: taxonomy wiring mostly done. ENG-4821: registry schema validation is in, but I’m still waiting on final IDs for 2 components (Dedicated control-plane + Console incidents rollup). Mina can you confirm? 

Mina Haddad: yep. for v1 public list, I propose:
- dedicated-control-plane (regionless)
- console (global)
we can add per-region later but don’t want to explode the page in phase 1.

Christine Wong: :thumbsup: works. I’ll lock those IDs today and update the registry + mapping file.

Ravi Menon: ENG-4830 tests are 80% — biggest gap is around “streaming vs chat” classification when gateway only has route prefix. Logan added metric tags in PR-19502 but we need to assert in tests that legacy routes fall back correctly.

Ravi Menon: I can finish tests tomorrow if I get a reviewer on the mapping rules. Christine you around?

Christine Wong: yep. tag me on the PR when ready. I can review mapping rules + edge cases (partial region, latency-only, etc).

Allison Grant: observability side: pr-19277 dashboards/links is merged. pr-19319 us-east streaming panels merged. pr-19302 anti-flap logic is in review — waiting for one more pass from SRE (hysteresis values).

Aisha Bello: I can take that review today. I want to confirm thresholds align with the “customer-facing status signals” standard (p95 latency + error% + burn windows). Allison can you link the standard doc in the PR description?

Allison Grant: will do. also, for ENG-4841 burn alerts: slo-toolkit pr-19190 is ready for approval. just needs someone from SRE to sanity check paging routing + runbook links.

Rafael Mendes: I’ll take pr-19190 review today. 

Devon Price: incident-bot: pr-19405 statuspage client w/ retry landed. pr-19388 comms lead role/reminders landed. pr-19344 draft generator is mostly good.

Devon Price: remaining: pr-19433 support approval step for sev0/sev1 is open. also need to align the “first update target” reminder copy with the templates.

Miles Thornton: for pr-19433, suggest default off behind a flag. we’ve seen approvals add latency unless severity truly high. maybe “required for sev0, optional for sev1”?

Rafael Mendes: agree on flag + severity gating. Devon, can you implement that or do you need help?

Devon Price: I can do it. I’ll push an update today. Need a Support approver name/role — Dev Patel asked for “Support lead on-call” vs hardcoding a person.

Talia Benson: I can coordinate w/ Dev Patel on what we want the selector to be (support-oncall rotation alias vs specific user group). I’ll DM and post back.

Elliot Price: docs: redwood-docs pr-18422 (public incident comms guidance) is in review. pr-18460 (post-incident summary format) drafted but needs legal/security sanity check.

Wei Chen: for tone/copy: I’m done with the template blocks (Investigating/Identified/Mitigating/Monitoring/Resolved). biggest debate is how explicit we are on “capacity constraints” language — avoiding customer-specific details.

Kira Thompson: on that: please avoid anything that implies dedicated customers are impacted unless we’ve confirmed it. suggested phrasing for shared components: “Some requests may experience elevated errors/latency” + specify product/region.

Wei Chen: got it. I’ll update templates to remove “capacity” mentions and stick to symptoms + mitigations.

Elliot Price: can we get Michael Grant + Naomi Feldman to do a quick pass on pr-18460? I can ping them but want alignment from SRE that this is ready.

Rafael Mendes: yes, ping legal+security for a quick review. keep it focused: “is this publishable + not overpromising.”

incident-bot: Reminder: Status page transparency weekly check-in actions are due by EOD Friday. Reply in thread with updates and link PRs/Linear tickets. 

Talia Benson: action items / assignments (proposed):
- Christine: finalize component IDs (dedicated-control-plane, console) + update registry today; review Ravi’s mapping tests
- Ravi: finish ENG-4830 tests tomorrow; link to PR here
- Aisha: review pr-19302 anti-flap values today
- Rafael: review pr-19190 burn alerts today
- Devon: update pr-19433 (approval step behind flag + sev gating) today/tomorrow
- Elliot: ping Michael+Naomi for pr-18460 review; keep pr-18422 moving
- Wei + Kira: final pass on templates wording re Dedicated/Private constraints by tomorrow

Talia Benson: did I miss anything?

Mina Haddad: small add: I’ll update the taxonomy doc with the “phase 1 vs phase 2” notes so we don’t keep reopening per-region/per-capability component explosion.

Allison Grant: +1. also, once anti-flap merges, we should run a quick game-day replay against the last streaming incident to make sure the component doesn’t toggle.

Rafael Mendes: good call. let’s schedule a 45m mini drill after pr-19302 merges. Talia can you coordinate time? aiming Thu.

Talia Benson: yep, I’ll send a hold for Thu afternoon PT and include links to the dashboards + runbook.

Devon Price: question: for pr-19344 drafts, do we want the first Investigating update to include “we’ll provide another update in X minutes” or keep it open-ended?

Wei Chen: suggest: “We’ll share another update within 30 minutes” only if we can consistently meet it. otherwise: “We’ll provide updates as we learn more.”

Rafael Mendes: we should avoid hard promises. keep it “we’ll provide updates as we learn more,” but we can keep internal reminder for TTFU targets.

Devon Price: ok, I’ll adjust the draft generator copy accordingly.

Christine Wong: FYI I’ll also include a small guardrail in registry validation: prevent duplicate display names across components. we had confusion last month when “API” was used for both chat + gateway.

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: love it. please ship.

Talia Benson: cool. please drop PR links as you post updates so I can roll them into PM-620 + the launch checklist.

Rafael Mendes: thanks all. next check-in same time next week unless we need an ad-hoc closer to rollout.
